scope: Model specification; current full-case admission is recorded separately in proof/status.json
repair: unsigned 32-bit subtraction before the original signed16 narrowing; original INT32_MIN unary-negation UB retained as counterexample

public_preconditions.outputs: two disjoint n-float writable arrays, initially uninitialized permitted
public_preconditions.params: separate preserved int32 zero_point and fp32 scale cells
public_preconditions.scale_domain: all binary32 values including all NaNs/Inf/signed zeros

lane_semantics.neon: wrap_s16(wrap_s16(-zero_point)+input_byte), then signed16-to-binary32, then fp32 multiply by scale
lane_semantics.rvv: wrap_s16(input_byte-wrap_s16(zero_point)), then signed16-to-binary32, then fp32 multiply by scale
lane_semantics.equality: cvt_delta_equiv and cvt_lane_equiv prove equality for arbitrary mathematical inputs, including the complete public domain
lane_semantics.tool_cast_boundary: actual narrow16 C helper body returns a cast of a single variable; arithmetic helpers call that checked body. Original expression-return cast capability failures retained separately, not treated as sound cast proofs

rvv.inactive_lanes: declared scalar representative; not a hardware tail-policy refinement claim

observation: Forall2 same_value: numeric equality or both NaN; NaN payload/sign and floating flags/traps excluded
formal_source_boundary: actual original/repaired C bodies plus declared scalar-field C intrinsics, exact typed generated VC interfaces, all callees require actual checked C bodies
